technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Framework's JdbcTemplate for JDBC source module to simplify database access.
Integrate with Redis using Jedis client library for the Redis sink.
Use Apache Curator for ZooKeeper security (ACL management) as it is a common Spring integration.
The Trigger abstraction will be extended by adding a new abstract class or interface with default methods, following existing patterns.
For Kafka sink, use the Kafka clients library (producer API) with Spring Kafka if available, else manual integration.
HTTPS will be enabled via Spring Boot's server.ssl properties, using a self-signed certificate for development and configuration for production.

The bug fix for grunt test will involve investigating the process spawning and socket hang-up issue, likely by ensuring the server is fully started before tests run or by using a different test execution strategy.
assumptions: The existing codebase is a Spring XD or similar data ingestion platform which already has build system and framework dependencies.
All required libraries (Jedis, Kafka client, Curator, etc.) are available and compatible with the current Spring version.
The developer is familiar with the existing codebase and Spring Framework conventions.
No external dependencies on other teams or third-party services for testing.
The effort estimates assume a single developer working full-time without interruptions.
Testing includes unit tests and integration tests with mock or embedded servers where possible.
Documentation for each feature is part of the implementation activity, except for user story U5 which explicitly requires guidance documentation.
The bug fix (U7) is straightforward and does not require major architectural changes.

activities.activity_description: Design and develop a JDBC source module to ingest data from databases, including configuration, connection pooling, query execution, and error handling. Includes unit and integration tests.
Design and develop a Redis sink module to ingest data into Redis, including configuration, client integration, data serialization, and error handling. Includes tests.
Add security for ZooKeeper nodes (ACL) to restrict access to zNodes. Use Apache Curator to manage ACLs. Includes configuration and testing.
Provide an extension point for Trigger abstraction so developers can implement custom triggers. Define interface/abstract class and provide documentation on how to use it.

activities.activity_name: Create Custom Module Guidance and Example
activities.activity_description: Develop an example module demonstrating best practices for creating custom modules. Write documentation explaining the steps and conventions.
Design and develop a Kafka sink module to publish data to Kafka topics. Includes configuration, producer setup, error handling, and integration tests.
Resolve the issue where running grunt test:e2e fails due to socket hang-up when server and tests run in same process. Implement fix and verify tests pass.

activities.activity_name: Enable HTTPS Support for Admin Server
activities.activity_description: Configure Spring Boot to enable HTTPS for the Admin server endpoints, including SSL certificate setup and configuration properties. Test secured access.
Integrate all new features, perform end-to-end system testing, regression testing, and final verification. Prepare release notes and ensure all components work together.
